[Sound: Glass shatters on stone.]

[Hard cut]

a figure in period dress: "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
[On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
a figure in period dress: "Then let them come with their torches!"
[On screen: Medium two-shot of the figure in period dress and the the figure in period dress, the space between them char…]
[Action: the figure in period dress slaps the cup from the the figure in period dress's hand and it shatters.]
a figure in period dress: "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
[Sound: Thunder cracks over the harbour.]
[On screen: High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.]
[Action: the man in period dress tears the lace veil and lets it fall.]
a figure in period dress: "The council has already decided her fate."
[On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's jaw tightening.]
a figure in period dress: "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
